text:
Izzy: Deploy bot created a lockfile for payments-ui during EU change window. values checksum mismatch with canary. Holding rollout — do we pin or rollback?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot created lockfile /releases/payments-ui/lock/1746723456. reason: values-hash mismatch. suggested actions: manual pin or rollback. :warning:

SRE-Oncall: :eyes: what's the delta? Is this config-only? Any DB migration planned?

Alex: No DB changes. Looks like feature flag default flipped (featureX: false -> true) in the new values. Canary observed ~7% CPU bump on 2/3 canary pods.

Jen: Can we hotfix values back to the previous default and re-trigger canary? Or pin chart version to previous digest and let traffic continue?

Sam: Pinning chart version is the fastest mitigation. But note the new chart also added a CRD; rolling forward later will need a compatibility step. Need release notes and a ticket.

Riley: If we pin, add an annotation to the lockfile explaining it's a temporary pin + follow-up ticket. I'll prepare the release-note blurb. Anyone object?

SRE-Oncall: Leaning rollback to the previous release rather than pin. If canary shows CPU bump, we risk a true regression in prod.

Alex: Rollback will cause ~30s pod restarts and might impact EU customers during the change window. Window is 03:00-05:00 UTC, lower traffic but not zero.

Izzy: Ops commands: `helm rollback payments-ui 45 --namespace prod-eu` or `helm upgrade --install payments-ui ./charts/payments-ui --version 3.1.9 -f values-prod.yaml` — pick one depending on release history.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot is holding the release until a manual ack. Use `/deploy ack 1746723456 --action pin` or `/deploy ack 1746723456 --action rollback`.

Jen: If we pin, run `kubectl get hpa -n prod-eu | grep payments-ui` and monitor for 15m before unblocking. Also set a short-term alert for CPU > 75%.

Sam: :thumbsup: Drafting the release note: "Pinned payments-ui to 3.1.9 due to canary config-induced CPU increase; temporary; follow-up ticket #INC-4821."

Riley: I can do the pin now if SRE-Oncall approves. SRE-Oncall?

SRE-Oncall: Approve pin + 15m monitor. If CPU stabilizes, we'll unhold and schedule a controlled rollforward with a config fix. Proceed.

Izzy: `/deploy ack 1746723456 --action pin --by Riley`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot acked action by Riley. lockfile updated: reason=pinned-to-3.1.9; note="temp pin, follow-up ticket INC-4821"; monitor=15m; status=held. :lock:

Alex: Added release-notes entry and backfilled changelog. Created a short canary runbook reference: docs/runbooks/payments-ui-canary.md

Jen: Running the HPA check and will post results in 10m. Will alert if any pod CPU > 80%.

SRE-Oncall: Thanks all. If this repeats on the next deploy we should open a postmortem. :memo:

Riley: :lock: Pin applied and annotated. Closing thread unless regressions observed.
